context:

Problem (goal): the cull removes the report check that asks for "Recovered" and "Handoff gave" lines, and with it the only count of handoff losses.
Based on (ruling): your answer on the handoff point, Nov 1: "I lean towards B if it works and maybe somehow log to see if i should revisit this consideration."

title: The cull drops the check that counted what a session lost at each handoff. Keep a count somewhere else?
why: You asked on Nov 1 for a log so you could revisit the handoff point.
